Hi Jamal — thanks for flagging and for the PO. Short answer: we do prorate seat increases that occur mid-billing-cycle; what you're seeing in the portal is the upcoming invoice preview which can default to showing the full-month quantity unless a finalized invoice has been generated.

Here's how we calculate it (we'll attach the spreadsheet with worked numbers):
- Billing cycle: monthly, 1st — last day of month (your account is on calendar-month cycles).
- Change date: 2026-10-18. Remaining days in cycle: 14 (Oct 18–31 inclusive). Total days in cycle: 31.
- New seats added: 7 (from 5 to 12).
- Unit price (monthly): $120/seat.
- Pro-rated charge = 7 seats * $120 * (14/31) = $3,806.45 (pre-tax)

VAT handling: because your billing address / VAT ID indicates the UK, we will apply VAT at the standard 20% rate on the prorated seat increment on the invoice. If you prefer the VAT to be reversed via a supplied VAT ID, please attach the VAT registration doc and we'll validate.

Next steps from our side:
- I will loop in Marcus in Billing to generate an updated invoice that includes the prorated line item and references PO 77892.
- I'll attach the detailed calculation and a PDF draft of the updated invoice for your AP.

Attachments I'm preparing: pro_rata_calc.xlsx (breakdown), updated_invoice_20261102.pdf (draft invoice).

Quick question: do you want us to issue a one-off charge for the prorated amount now, or include it on the next scheduled invoice as a line item? We can do either; if you need payment before the next invoice date we can send a proforma/one-off invoice.

Best,
